layer6_toolbox.intro: 柏拉图、鱼骨、OEE、SPC、5Why、MSA、FMEA、SMED、VSM、TPM、安灯、BOM 成本、防错、标准工时、单位成本、瓶颈、供应商评分、OTIF——18 种制造业常用分析方法。左侧第六层可逐条点开；每种方法按教材体展开并配演示图。

methods.title: 柏拉图（帕累托）
methods.desc: 把不良原因按出现次数从高到低排，前几个通常就是主要问题
methods.bizQuestion: 哪些不良原因最值得优先改善？
methods.portfolio: 前3类不良（尺寸偏差/表面划伤/材料缺陷）占总不良的78%。见不良分析看板 v_defect_analysis。

methods.title: 鱼骨图（因果分析）
methods.desc: 从人/机/料/法/环五个维度找问题根源
methods.bizQuestion: 良品率下降的根因是什么？
methods.portfolio: 2025-04华东工厂良品率降至88% → 鱼骨图 → 定位「设备校准不及时」。见质量分析看板。

methods.title: 统计过程控制（SPC）
methods.desc: 画控制图看生产过程是否稳定
methods.portfolio: F02-L02产线良品率超出控制界限 → 触发预警 → 原料批次异常。见 dws_quality_daily。

methods.title: 5Why分析
methods.desc: 连续问5个「为什么」追到根因
methods.bizQuestion: 尺寸偏差为什么反复出现？
methods.portfolio: 为什么良品率低→为什么尺寸偏差→为什么刀具磨损→为什么没及时更换→为什么没有点检制度。

methods.title: 测量系统分析（MSA）
methods.desc: 先确认量具/检验可靠，再信数据做判断
methods.bizQuestion: 这套量具能不能放心用来判良品？
methods.portfolio: 尺寸检具 %GRR=28%（临界）→ 先复训操作与夹具定位，再重算 SPC 限。见质量分析相关量测记录。

methods.title: FMEA（失效模式与影响分析）
methods.desc: 量产前把「可能坏在哪」按风险排序
methods.bizQuestion: 新品量产前，最高风险失效防住了吗？
methods.portfolio: NPI 焊接工序 RPN 高项「虚焊」→ 增加影像探测 + 扭矩防错。见新品导入评估路径。

methods.title: OEE分析
methods.desc: 把设备效率拆成：开了多久、跑多快、出了多少良品
methods.portfolio: OEE=85%（可用率92%×性能率95%×良品率97%）。见 v_equipment_oee。

methods.title: 产能瓶颈分析
methods.desc: 找出整条产线中效率最低的环节
methods.portfolio: 组装工序产能60件/小时，其他工序>80件 → 瓶颈在组装。见 v_capacity_utilization。

methods.title: 快速换型（SMED）
methods.desc: 把换型时间拆开，能外置的先做，缩短停机
methods.bizQuestion: 换型能不能从 45 分钟压到 12 分钟？
methods.portfolio: F02 组装换型 42→15 分钟（工具外置+快换夹具），可用率 +4pct。见停机损失看板换型明细。

methods.title: 单位成本趋势分析
methods.desc: 追踪每个月单位成本的变化
methods.portfolio: 单位成本从120元涨到135元 → 拆解发现材料成本上涨导致。见 v_cost_analysis。

methods.title: 供应商评分卡
methods.desc: 从质量、交付、价格三个维度给供应商打分
methods.portfolio: 供应商A综合92分（质量95/交付88/价格93）→ 续约优先。见 v_supply_chain。

methods.title: OTIF / 准时齐套交付
methods.desc: 既要按时，还要数量与质量一次到位
methods.bizQuestion: 客户眼里的交付达标率到底多少？
methods.portfolio: OTIF 86%：延误主因缺料 55%、产能 30%、物流 15%。见交付分析看板。

methods.title: BOM 成本卷积
methods.desc: 按物料清单一层层把成本滚到成品
methods.bizQuestion: 这款产品成本主要滚在哪些件上？
methods.portfolio: 成品 P-200 材料成本中连接器占 22%，涨价直接打穿毛利。见成本分析 / 领料差异。

methods.title: 标准工时分析
methods.desc: 用标准时间算产能、定员和效率
methods.bizQuestion: 加班是因为单量真大，还是效率不够？
methods.portfolio: 组装标准 1.2 分/件，实际 1.6 分 → 方法浪费为主。见人工效率看板。

methods.title: 价值流图（VSM）
methods.desc: 画出从原料到出货哪里增值、哪里浪费
methods.bizQuestion: 订单交期里真正加工只占多少？
methods.portfolio: P 族增值比 4.8%，等待与仓库占大部分 → 优先压缩组装前 WIP。见产能/交付看板。

methods.title: TPM（全员生产维护）
methods.desc: 把保养从「维修班的事」变成全员日常
methods.bizQuestion: 故障能不能靠日常点检压下去？
methods.portfolio: F02 推行自主保养 8 周后非计划停机 -35%。见设备 OEE / 停机损失。

methods.title: 安灯（Andon）异常响应
methods.desc: 一有异常就拉灯，快速停线解决
methods.bizQuestion: 现场异常平均多久才有人到？
methods.portfolio: 缺料类安灯占 41%，平均响应 12 分钟→齐套改善后下降。见生产总览异常记录。

methods.title: 防错（Poka-Yoke）
methods.desc: 从设计上让错做不出来，不靠人盯
methods.bizQuestion: 这类装错能不能从结构上杜绝？
methods.portfolio: 连接器防呆卡槽 + 扫码互锁后混装客诉归零。见质量分析。

nextSteps: 横展→FMEA/控制计划更新

playbooks.title: 班组绩效排名
playbooks.desc: 各班组产量、良率、效率对比
playbooks.bizQuestion: 哪个班表现最好？哪个班拖后腿？

steps.title: 班组产量与良率
steps.sql: SELECT shift_code, SUM(output_qty) output, AVG(yield_rate_pct) yield, AVG(capacity_util_pct) util FROM dws_production_daily WHERE shift_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY shift_code ORDER BY output DESC

steps.title: 班组人均产出
steps.sql: SELECT shift_code, ROUND(SUM(output_qty)/COUNT(DISTINCT operator_id), 1) per_capita FROM dws_production_daily WHERE shift_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY shift_code ORDER BY per_capita DESC

nextSteps: 低绩效班组→人工效率评估 / 培训需求分析

playbooks.title: 产品盈利能力分析
playbooks.desc: 各产品/产品线的收入、成本、毛利对比
playbooks.bizQuestion: 哪款产品最赚钱？哪款在亏钱？

steps.title: 产品毛利排名
steps.sql: SELECT product_code, SUM(output_qty) qty, SUM(total_cost) cost, ROUND(SUM(total_cost)/NULLIF(SUM(output_qty),0),2) unit_cost, 0 AS revenue, 0 AS gross_margin FROM dws_cost_monthly WHERE product_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_code ORDER BY unit_cost DESC

steps.title: 产品成本结构
steps.sql: SELECT product_code, SUM(material_cost) mat, SUM(labor_cost) lab, SUM(overhead_cost) oh FROM dws_cost_monthly WHERE product_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_code

nextSteps: 低毛利产品→单位成本上升诊断 / 产品定价优化

playbooks.title: 工序良率总览
playbooks.desc: 各工序良率、FPY、瓶颈工序识别
playbooks.bizQuestion: 哪道工序良率最低？质量瓶颈在哪？

steps.title: 工序良率排名
steps.sql: SELECT process_code, AVG(yield_rate_pct) yield, AVG(first_pass_pct) fpy FROM dws_quality_daily WHERE process_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY process_code ORDER BY yield ASC
steps.output: 工序良率从低到高排名

steps.title: 工序不良分布
steps.sql: SELECT process_code, defect_type, SUM(defect_qty) qty FROM v_defect_analysis WHERE process_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY process_code, defect_type ORDER BY qty DESC

nextSteps: 低良率工序→报废返工上升诊断 / 工序良率提升

playbooks.title: 能耗总览
playbooks.desc: 电、气、水等能耗总量、单耗、趋势
playbooks.bizQuestion: 本月能耗情况怎么样？单耗达标吗？

steps.title: 月度能耗总量
steps.sql: SELECT snapshot_month, SUM(elec_kwh) elec, SUM(gas_nm3) gas, SUM(water_ton) water FROM dws_energy_monthly GROUP BY snapshot_month ORDER BY snapshot_month DESC LIMIT 12

steps.title: 单位产品能耗
steps.sql: SELECT e.snapshot_month, ROUND(SUM(e.elec_kwh)/NULLIF(SUM(p.output_qty),0),2) kwh_per_unit FROM dws_energy_monthly e JOIN dws_production_daily p ON DATE_FORMAT(e.snapshot_month,'%Y-%m')=DATE_FORMAT(p.snapshot_date,'%Y-%m') GROUP BY e.snapshot_month ORDER BY e.snapshot_month DESC

nextSteps: 单耗上升→能耗上升诊断

playbooks.title: 客户交付分析
playbooks.desc: 按客户维度的OTIF、欠交、订单满足率
playbooks.bizQuestion: 哪些客户交付最差？客户满意度风险在哪？

steps.title: 客户OTIF排名
steps.sql: SELECT customer_code, AVG(on_time_delivery_pct) otif, COUNT(*) order_cnt FROM dws_delivery_daily WHERE customer_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_code ORDER BY otif ASC

steps.title: 客户欠交金额
steps.sql: SELECT customer_code, SUM(shortage_qty) shortage, SUM(order_qty) total FROM dws_delivery_daily WHERE customer_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_code ORDER BY shortage DESC

nextSteps: 低OTIF客户→交期延误诊断

playbooks.title: 安全生产概况
playbooks.desc: 事故次数、隐患整改、安全培训完成率
playbooks.bizQuestion: 本月安全状况怎么样？有哪些风险点？

steps.title: 安全事故统计
steps.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(accident_date,'%Y-%m') month, COUNT(*) cnt, SUM(severity_score) severity FROM dws_safety_accident GROUP BY month ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 12

steps.title: 隐患整改率
steps.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(find_date,'%Y-%m') month, COUNT(*) total, SUM(CASE WHEN status='closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) closed, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status='closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*)*100,1) close_rate FROM dws_safety_hazard GROUP BY month ORDER BY month DESC

nextSteps: 事故上升→安全事故根因分析

playbooks.title: 能耗上升诊断
playbooks.desc: 拆产品→工序→设备→时段，定位能耗上升原因
playbooks.bizQuestion: 为什么这个月电费涨了这么多？

steps.title: 分产品单耗对比
steps.sql: SELECT product_code, AVG(elec_kwh/output_qty) unit_kwh FROM dws_energy_monthly WHERE snapshot_month BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURDATE(),INTERVAL 2 MONTH) AND CURDATE() GROUP BY product_code ORDER BY unit_kwh DESC

steps.title: 分设备能耗排名
steps.sql: SELECT equipment_code, SUM(elec_kwh) elec, SUM(runtime_hours) runtime, ROUND(SUM(elec_kwh)/NULLIF(SUM(runtime_hours),0),2) kwh_per_hour FROM dws_equipment_energy GROUP BY equipment_code ORDER BY elec DESC LIMIT 10

nextSteps: 高耗能设备→设备OEE评估 / 节能改造立项

playbooks.title: 人工成本上升诊断
playbooks.desc: 拆产量→效率→加班→单价，定位人工成本上涨原因
playbooks.bizQuestion: 为什么人工成本涨了？是加人了还是效率降了？

steps.title: 单位人工成本趋势
steps.sql: SELECT snapshot_month, SUM(labor_cost) labor, SUM(output_qty) qty, ROUND(SUM(labor_cost)/NULLIF(SUM(output_qty),0),2) unit_labor FROM dws_cost_monthly GROUP BY snapshot_month ORDER BY snapshot_month DESC LIMIT 12

steps.title: 加班占比分析
steps.sql: SELECT shift_code, SUM(overtime_hours) ot, SUM(regular_hours) reg, ROUND(SUM(overtime_hours)/NULLIF(SUM(regular_hours),0)*100,1) ot_rate FROM dws_labor_hourly GROUP BY shift_code ORDER BY ot_rate DESC

nextSteps: 效率偏低→人工效率评估 / 排班优化

playbooks.title: 客诉上升诊断
playbooks.desc: 拆客户→产品→不良类型→批次，定位客诉上升根因
playbooks.bizQuestion: 为什么客诉突然变多了？哪类问题最严重？

steps.title: 客诉类型分布
steps.sql: SELECT complaint_type, COUNT(*) cnt, SUM(severity_score) severity FROM dws_customer_complaint WHERE complaint_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(),INTERVAL 3 MONTH) GROUP BY complaint_type ORDER BY cnt DESC

steps.title: 客诉产品分布
steps.sql: SELECT product_code, COUNT(*) cnt, SUM(return_qty) return_qty FROM dws_customer_complaint WHERE complaint_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(),INTERVAL 3 MONTH) GROUP BY product_code ORDER BY cnt DESC

nextSteps: TOP客诉类型→质量改善优先级 / 8D闭环

playbooks.title: 安全事故根因分析
playbooks.desc: 拆类型→部位→时段→原因，定位安全事故规律
playbooks.bizQuestion: 为什么事故变多了？根因是什么？

steps.title: 事故类型分布
steps.sql: SELECT accident_type, COUNT(*) cnt, SUM(severity_score) severity FROM dws_safety_accident WHERE accident_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(),INTERVAL 6 MONTH) GROUP BY accident_type ORDER BY severity DESC

steps.title: 事故时段分析
steps.sql: SELECT HOUR(accident_time) hour, COUNT(*) cnt FROM dws_safety_accident WHERE accident_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(),INTERVAL 6 MONTH) GROUP BY HOUR(accident_time) ORDER BY cnt DESC

nextSteps: 系统性隐患→安全管理体系优化

playbooks.title: 物料损耗上升诊断
playbooks.desc: 拆物料→工序→原因，定位物料损耗上升点
playbooks.bizQuestion: 为什么物料损耗率超标了？浪费在哪？

steps.title: 物料损耗排名
steps.sql: SELECT material_code, SUM(scrap_qty) scrap, SUM(issue_qty) issue, ROUND(SUM(scrap_qty)/NULLIF(SUM(issue_qty),0)*100,2) scrap_rate FROM dws_material_daily GROUP BY material_code ORDER BY scrap_rate DESC LIMIT 10

steps.title: 工序损耗分布
steps.sql: SELECT process_code, SUM(scrap_qty) scrap, SUM(issue_qty) issue, ROUND(SUM(scrap_qty)/NULLIF(SUM(issue_qty),0)*100,2) scrap_rate FROM dws_material_daily WHERE process_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY process_code ORDER BY scrap_rate DESC

nextSteps: 高损耗工序→质量改善 / 工艺优化

playbooks.title: 换型时间过长诊断
playbooks.desc: 拆产品→产线→换型类型，定位换型损失大头
playbooks.bizQuestion: 为什么换型要这么久？时间都花在哪了？
triggers: 多品种小批量产能不足

steps.title: 换型时长排名
steps.sql: SELECT line_code, AVG(changeover_minutes) avg_co, COUNT(*) co_cnt FROM dws_changeover GROUP BY line_code ORDER BY avg_co DESC

steps.title: 换型步骤拆解
steps.sql: SELECT changeover_step, AVG(duration_min) avg_dur, SUM(duration_min) total FROM dws_changeover_detail GROUP BY changeover_step ORDER BY total DESC

nextSteps: 长换型→快速换型SMED / 排程优化

playbooks.title: 瓶颈工序漂移诊断
playbooks.desc: 跟踪瓶颈工序是否转移，识别新的约束点
playbooks.bizQuestion: 瓶颈工序是不是变了？现在卡在哪？

steps.title: 各工序利用率趋势
steps.sql: SELECT process_code, DATE_FORMAT(snapshot_date,'%Y-%m') month, AVG(capacity_util_pct) util FROM dws_production_daily WHERE process_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY process_code, month ORDER BY month DESC, util DESC

steps.title: WIP堆积点变化
steps.sql: SELECT process_code, AVG(wip_qty) avg_wip FROM dws_wip_daily WHERE snapshot_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY process_code ORDER BY avg_wip DESC

nextSteps: 新瓶颈→产能不足诊断 / 排程优化

playbooks.title: 安全库存预警
playbooks.desc: 基于消耗速度和交期，识别低于安全库存的物料
playbooks.bizQuestion: 哪些物料快断货了？需要紧急采购吗？

steps.title: 库存低于安全线物料
steps.sql: SELECT m.material_code, m.on_hand_qty, m.safety_stock, m.lead_time_days, ROUND(m.on_hand_qty / NULLIF(AVG(daily_usage),0),1) days_cover FROM dws_material_inventory m JOIN (SELECT material_code, AVG(issue_qty) daily_usage FROM dws_material_daily WHERE snapshot_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY material_code) u ON m.material_code=u.material_code WHERE m.on_hand_qty < m.safety_stock ORDER BY days_cover ASC

steps.title: 未来30天需求预测
steps.sql: SELECT material_code, AVG(issue_qty)*30 forecast_30d FROM dws_material_daily WHERE snapshot_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(),INTERVAL 90 DAY) GROUP BY material_code ORDER BY forecast_30d DESC

nextSteps: 缺货风险→物料需求预测 / 供应商份额优化

playbooks.title: 能耗预测与预算
playbooks.desc: 基于产量计划预测下月能耗，对比预算识别缺口
playbooks.bizQuestion: 下月能耗预算够不够？需要追加吗？

steps.title: 历史单耗基线
steps.sql: SELECT snapshot_month, SUM(elec_kwh) elec, SUM(output_qty) qty, ROUND(SUM(elec_kwh)/NULLIF(SUM(output_qty),0),2) unit_kwh FROM dws_energy_monthly GROUP BY snapshot_month ORDER BY snapshot_month DESC LIMIT 12

steps.title: 下月能耗预测
steps.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(unit_kwh) * :next_month_output, 0) forecast_elec, ROUND(AVG(unit_kwh) * :next_month_output * :elec_price, 2) forecast_cost FROM (SELECT SUM(elec_kwh)/NULLIF(SUM(output_qty),0) unit_kwh FROM dws_energy_monthly WHERE snapshot_month >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(),INTERVAL 6 MONTH)) t

nextSteps: 预算缺口→能耗上升诊断 / 节能项目立项

playbooks.title: 人力需求预测
playbooks.desc: 基于产量计划和标准工时，预测下月人力需求
playbooks.bizQuestion: 下月需要多少人？现在的人够吗？

steps.title: 标准工时与需求工时
steps.sql: SELECT p.product_code, p.plan_qty, s.std_minute_per_unit, ROUND(p.plan_qty * s.std_minute_per_unit / 60, 1) demand_hours FROM mps_plan p JOIN std_time s ON p.product_code=s.product_code WHERE p.plan_month=DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(CURDATE(),INTERVAL 1 MONTH),'%Y-%m')

steps.title: 现有产能与缺口
steps.sql: SELECT shift_code, COUNT(*) headcount, SUM(available_hours) available_hours FROM labor_capacity WHERE month=DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(CURDATE(),INTERVAL 1 MONTH),'%Y-%m') GROUP BY shift_code

nextSteps: 人力缺口→人员排班优化 / 外包决策

playbooks.title: 质量风险预测
playbooks.desc: 基于过程参数趋势，预测质量风险点
playbooks.bizQuestion: 哪些产品/工序下月质量风险高？

steps.title: 过程能力指数趋势
steps.sql: SELECT process_code, product_code, DATE_FORMAT(snapshot_date,'%Y-%m') month, AVG(cpk) avg_cpk FROM dws_spc_daily WHERE process_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY process_code, product_code, month ORDER BY month DESC, avg_cpk ASC

steps.title: 低CPK风险清单
steps.sql: SELECT process_code, product_code, AVG(cpk) cpk FROM dws_spc_daily WHERE snapshot_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY process_code, product_code HAVING cpk < 1.33 ORDER BY cpk ASC

nextSteps: 高风险工序→SPC监控加强 / FMEA更新

playbooks.title: 产品盈利能力评估
playbooks.desc: 从毛利、周转、销量多维度评估产品价值
playbooks.bizQuestion: 哪些产品是金牛？哪些是瘦狗？

steps.title: 产品毛利与周转
steps.sql: SELECT product_code, SUM(gross_profit) profit, AVG(inventory_turnover_days) turn_days, SUM(output_qty) qty FROM dws_cost_monthly WHERE product_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_code ORDER BY profit DESC

steps.title: BCG矩阵分类
steps.sql: SELECT product_code, CASE WHEN profit_rank<=10 AND growth_rank<=10 THEN '明星' WHEN profit_rank<=10 AND growth_rank>10 THEN '金牛' WHEN profit_rank>10 AND growth_rank<=10 THEN '问题' ELSE '瘦狗' END bcg_type FROM (SELECT product_code, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY gross_profit DESC) profit_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY growth_rate DESC) growth_rank FROM product_monthly) t

outputs: 产品盈利能力评估报告
nextSteps: 瘦狗产品→停产决策 / 产品升级

playbooks.title: 客户价值评估
playbooks.desc: 从收入、利润、交付、风险多维度评估客户价值
playbooks.bizQuestion: 哪些客户是高价值客户？哪些需要策略调整？

steps.title: 客户收入与毛利
steps.sql: SELECT customer_code, SUM(revenue) revenue, SUM(gross_profit) profit, ROUND(SUM(gross_profit)/NULLIF(SUM(revenue),0)*100,2) margin FROM dws_sales_monthly WHERE customer_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_code ORDER BY profit DESC

steps.title: 客户交付与风险
steps.sql: SELECT customer_code, AVG(on_time_delivery_pct) otif, COUNT(complaint_id) complaint_cnt FROM dws_customer_daily WHERE customer_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_code ORDER BY otif ASC

nextSteps: 低价值客户→定价调整 / 服务优化

playbooks.title: 班组绩效综合评估
playbooks.desc: 从产量、质量、效率、安全多维度综合评估班组
playbooks.bizQuestion: 哪个班组综合表现最好？差距在哪？

steps.title: 各班组多指标对比
steps.sql: SELECT shift_code, AVG(output_qty) output, AVG(yield_rate_pct) yield, AVG(labor_eff) eff, AVG(safety_score) safety FROM dws_shift_daily GROUP BY shift_code
steps.output: 班组多指标雷达图数据

steps.title: 综合评分与排名
steps.sql: SELECT shift_code, ROUND(0.3*output_score + 0.3*yield_score + 0.2*eff_score + 0.2*safety_score, 1) total_score FROM shift_scorecard ORDER BY total_score DESC

nextSteps: 落后班组→针对性培训 / 管理改进

playbooks.title: 生产排程优化
playbooks.desc: 基于瓶颈、换型、交期优化排产顺序，提升产能和交付
playbooks.bizQuestion: 怎么排产能让产出最多、交付最好？

steps.title: 瓶颈工序与订单池
steps.sql: SELECT p.order_id, p.product_code, p.quantity, p.due_date, s.setup_time, s.run_time_per_unit FROM mps_orders p JOIN product_routing s ON p.product_code=s.product_code WHERE p.status='pending' ORDER BY p.due_date

steps.title: 优化排程模拟
steps.sql: SELECT order_id, product_code, start_time, end_time, setup_time, run_time FROM schedule_simulation WHERE scenario='optimized' ORDER BY start_time
steps.output: 优化后排程甘特图数据

nextSteps: 排程优化→快速换型SMED / 瓶颈扩能

playbooks.title: 能耗优化方案
playbooks.desc: 从设备、工艺、管理三方面制定节能降耗方案
playbooks.bizQuestion: 怎么把能耗降下来？投入产出比怎么样？

steps.title: 节能机会识别
steps.sql: SELECT equipment_code, SUM(elec_kwh) annual_elec, potential_save_pct, ROUND(SUM(elec_kwh)*potential_save_pct/100*elec_price, 0) annual_save, investment, ROUND(investment / NULLIF(SUM(elec_kwh)*potential_save_pct/100*elec_price/12,0), 1) payback_months FROM energy_saving_opportunities GROUP BY equipment_code ORDER BY annual_save DESC

steps.title: 优化方案优先级
steps.sql: SELECT measure, category, investment, annual_save, payback_months, risk_level FROM energy_saving_plan ORDER BY payback_months ASC, annual_save DESC

nextSteps: 高ROI项目→立项实施 / 效果验证

playbooks.title: 人员排班优化
playbooks.desc: 基于产量波动和人员技能，优化班次和人员配置
playbooks.bizQuestion: 怎么排班既能满足生产又不浪费人力？

steps.title: 产量波动与人力需求
steps.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(snapshot_date,'%Y-%m-%d') date, shift_code, SUM(output_qty) output, SUM(required_hours) demand FROM dws_production_daily WHERE snapshot_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY date, shift_code ORDER BY date

steps.title: 技能矩阵与调配方案
steps.sql: SELECT employee_id, name, shift_code, skill_level, COUNT(DISTINCT process_code) skill_count FROM employee_skill_matrix ORDER BY skill_count DESC

nextSteps: 技能缺口→培训计划 / 多技能工培养

playbooks.title: 物料配送路径优化
playbooks.desc: 优化厂内物料配送路线和频次，降低物流成本和等待
playbooks.bizQuestion: 怎么送料能又快又省？配送路线怎么优化？

steps.title: 配送现状分析
steps.sql: SELECT route_id, AVG(delivery_time_min) avg_time, AVG(distance_m) avg_dist, COUNT(delivery_id) daily_cnt FROM warehouse_delivery WHERE snapshot_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY route_id ORDER BY avg_time DESC

steps.title: 优化后路径模拟
steps.sql: SELECT route_id, optimized_distance_m, optimized_time_min, saving_pct, annual_cost_saving FROM delivery_optimization ORDER BY annual_cost_saving DESC

nextSteps: 配送优化→智能仓储 / AGV引入评估
